references.text: The priest shall take some of the blood and put it on the horns of the altar for the fragrant incense that stands before the Lord's presence. The same ritual of applying blood to the horns of the altar with a finger.
The blood shall be put on the horns of the altar. Parallel text about the blood ritual in the sin offering.
The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the burnt offering altar, and he shall pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
The priest shall take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the burnt offering altar, and all the remaining blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the burnt offering altar. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

Moses slaughtered the bull, took its blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger to cleanse the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. A direct parallel to the consecration ritual.
Aaron's sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar. The rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.
You shall take some of the blood and put it on the four horns, on the corners of the ledge, and on the rim all around. Ezekiel's vision of the future temple with a similar blood ritual.
The book of Hebrews explains how blood was used for cleansing in the old covenant and points forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice.
